name: 邮件草稿
description: 官方插件:真实邮箱(IMAP 收件/搜索/读取)+ 邮件草稿与 SMTP 真实发送 + 右栏面板(收件箱/草稿箱/账号)

tools.name: mail_list_emails
tools.description: List recent emails from a mailbox (default INBOX), newest first, with read/unread state. Use when the user asks what mail they have or wants to check the inbox. Returns uid, subject, sender, date — pass the uid to mail_read.

limit.description: How many emails to return, 1-50. Default: 20

tools.name: mail_search
tools.description: Search emails by matching the query against subject/sender/recipient within a recent window (add since to bound how far back the server scans). Use when the user looks for mail from someone or about something.

query.description: Keyword matched against subject and sender/recipient names & addresses

since.description: Optional date bound (ISO, e.g. 2026-09-01) limiting how far back to scan

limit.description: How many emails to return, 1-50. Default: 20

tools.name: mail_read
tools.description: Read one email in full: headers, plain-text body and attachment names. Marks the email as read. The id is the uid from mail_list_emails / mail_search.

id.description: The uid of the email to read

mailbox.description: Mailbox/folder the email is in. Default: INBOX

tools.name: mail_create_draft
tools.description: Create an email draft (to / subject / body). The draft appears in the mail panel for the user to review; mail_send_draft delivers it. Use whenever the user asks to write or reply to an email. When replying, quote the original in the body.

to.description: Recipient email address (multiple addresses separated by commas)

tools.name: mail_list_drafts
tools.description: List all email drafts with their status.

tools.name: mail_send_draft
tools.description: Deliver an existing draft via SMTP for real. Matches an unsent draft by subject (exact or prefix, most recent wins). Requires a configured account (mail panel → 账号). ONLY call this when the user explicitly asked to send the email — for anything less, create the draft and let the user send it from the panel.

subject.description: Subject of the draft to send (exact or prefix match)
